title: Back Rank
description: The Black king is trapped behind its own pawns. Swing the rook to the back rank.

title: Queen's Visit
description: The pawns that shelter the king also imprison it. Find the queen check on the eighth rank.

title: Smothered
description: The king is boxed in by its own rook and pawns. Only the knight can reach it.

title: Queen and King
description: Your king guards the escape squares. Deliver the queen check that ends it.

title: Supported Queen
description: Step the queen right next to the king — your own king defends her.

title: Rook and King
description: The classic rook checkmate. Your king covers the escape; the rook delivers the blow.
